children: SSE plc is today hosting an in-person investor relations event in Aberdeen for sell-side analysts and institutional investors.

The event will focus on the SSEN Transmission business with Rob McDonald, Managing Director of SSEN Transmission, and the wider management team detailing the progress being made in delivering its £29bn RIIO-T3 investment plan, including status updates on key projects and deep dives into areas such as asset management, project delivery, finance and regulation.  This will then be followed by visits to two sites under construction - Eastern Green Link 2 and Netherton Hub.
No material new financial information or new targets will be shared at the event.
A copy of the presentation materials will be made available on https://www.sse.com/investors/reports-and-results/ shortly after the event.
